capabilities: Filter the file explorer by substring of the full file path
Open a folder in a narrowed folder view with navigation and creation inside it
Hide non-matching paragraphs in the editor, optionally collapsed to an ellipsis
Combine terms with ; & - operators and quoted phrases, including task keywords todo and done
Filter tables by row and keep ancestor headers visible with Preserve structure
extras: Filtering in reading mode is described as known to be buggy; the filter is designed for editing mode (Live Preview / Source).
problem: Obsidian's file explorer and editor have no built-in way to narrow visible files or paragraphs to those matching a query while working.
summary: Live filter plugin that hides non-matching files in the file explorer and non-matching paragraphs in the editor, with include/exclude modes and query operators.
